about:
Creative Wood Designs operates from Bismarck, North Dakota, where it has served homeowners across the central and western regions of the state for over 25 years. The company was established to provide European-style custom cabinetry, though the exact founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The Bismarck-based workshop produces custom cabinetry in a range of styles, finishes, and hardware options, tailoring each project to the client's vision. Details about facility size, headcount, or annual volume are not published.

Its customer base consists primarily of residential clients in Central and Western North Dakota seeking custom cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, and other living spaces. The company does not appear to target commercial or industrial accounts.

Creative Wood Designs emphasizes its blend of decades-long experience with modern design sensibilities, positioning its European-inspired aesthetic and premium finish selection as key differentiators in the regional market.
